system.description: All hostile units within 4 Rng of this unit have -4 Wit, Cha and Res.
A mineral infused with natural magical power. Used to enhance equipment, fuel magical devices, or as a core crafting material for enchanted items.
Protected from Wind and Shadow damage. Vulnerable to Slashing, Missile, Arcane and Holy damage.

The revenant's orb glows a bright violet, then jets out a piercing bolt of shadow at its victim.

Breaker against all magic types.
